title.narrative: Establishing a strategic Green Transaction Advisory Package (Green-TAP) for PT Sarana Multi Infrastruktur

description.narrative: The Green-TAP aims to provide a targeted transaction advisory package to PT SMI (Ministry of Finance owned ‘Special Mission Vehicle’ which is engaged in financing and preparing infrastructure projects) on a portfolio of renewable energy (RE) projects that require ‘last mile’ support in the PT SMI pipeline. The priority portfolio consists of seven RE projects totaling to a total investment size of USD 83 million capex and represents an installation capacity of 45 MW RE.

Thus Green-TAP can act as a real catalyst to pushing the projects pipeline towards financial closure. Green-TAP is envisioned to be a complementary facility that be deployed in parallel to multiple projects – thus supporting green lending at PT SMI to take the projects towards financing. Specialized consultants would be hired in addition to GGGI staff resources to deliver the transaction advisory.
